record.paper_title: Some Open Problems and Conjectures on Submanifolds of Finite Type: Recent Development
record.original_question: Classify all hypersurfaces M in Euclidean space Eⁿ⁺¹ whose position vector field x has a finite spectral decomposition x = c + x₁ + ··· + x_k, where c is a constant vector, the x_i are non-constant Eᵐ-valued maps, and each satisfies Δx_i = λ_i x_i for some real eigenvalue λ_i. In particular, classify all such finite-type surfaces in E³.

evidence.quote: The immersion x is said to be of finite type if the position vector field of M in E^m, also denoted by x, can be expressed as a finite sum of E^m-valued eigenfunctions of the Laplace operator... x = c + x1 + x2 +...+ xk ... Δxi = λi xi, i = 1,...,k.
Problem 1. Classify all finite type hypersurfaces in E^(n+1). In particular, classify all finite type surfaces in E^3.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $x : M^n \to \mathbb{E}^{n+1}$ be an isometric immersion of a connected hypersurface into Euclidean $(n+1)$-space, and let $\Delta$ denote the Laplace–Beltrami operator of the induced metric on $M$. The immersion (or the hypersurface) is said to be of finite type if its position vector field $x$ admits a finite spectral decomposition
$$x \;=\; c + x_1 + x_2 + \cdots + x_k,$$
where $c \in \mathbb{E}^{n+1}$ is a constant vector, each $x_i : M \to \mathbb{E}^{n+1}$ is a non-constant smooth $\mathbb{E}^{n+1}$-valued map, and there exist real numbers $\lambda_1, \ldots, \lambda_k$ such that
$$\Delta x_i = \lambda_i\, x_i, \qquad i = 1, \ldots, k.$$

(a) Classify, up to congruence, all finite-type hypersurfaces $M^n$ in $\mathbb{E}^{n+1}$.

(b) In particular, classify all finite-type surfaces $M^2$ in $\mathbb{E}^3$.
artifact.status_search_result: The classification of finite-type surfaces in $\mathbb{E}^3$ remains a long-standing open problem first posed by B.-Y. Chen in the 1980s. To date, the only known finite-type surfaces in $\mathbb{E}^3$ are (open portions of) planes, round spheres, circular cylinders, and minimal surfaces; no other examples have been found, but a complete classification has not been established. Related results exist in pseudo-Euclidean spaces, for surfaces with respect to other fundamental forms, and for restricted classes (ruled, factorable, quadric Gauss-map type), but the general problem and its hypersurface generalization are still open.

status_evidence.title: On Surfaces of finite Chen-type
status_evidence.snippet: The only known finite Chen-type surfaces in E^3 are portions of spheres, circular cylinders and minimal surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: The classification problem remains open; only a limited family of examples is known.

status_evidence.title: On Surfaces of Finite Type in Euclidean 3-Space
status_evidence.snippet: Studies surfaces of finite type in E^3, restricted classes considered in the absence of a full classification.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist for restricted classes but the general classification in E^3 is unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Quadrics with finite Chen-type Gauss map
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates particular classes within the finite-type framework, indicating ongoing research towards Chen's classification problem.
status_evidence.claim: Active research continues on subclasses of Chen's finite-type problem.
